_README: This is the ONLY file you need to edit. url + email, feeds (jobs + results/admit-cards), caps per run. The automation runs 6x/day; data/last-run.json shows how the last run went.
_adsNote: Ads: adsenseId = your AdSense publisher ID (ca-pub-…), adsenseSlot = optional in-article ad unit ID. admob = the Android app's AdMob IDs (appId ca-app-pub-…~…, banner/inline/interstitial ca-app-pub-…/…); a change here rebuilds the app. appAds = app ad switches, applied to installed apps within minutes.
_feedsNote: Dead feeds removed 2026-10-15 (govtjobsblog, govtjobsdiary, sarkarifeed, gulfwalkin, gccwalkins). data/last-run.json shows per-feed health each run.

payRates._note: Single source for all salary/tax tools. Update daPercent when the government notifies a new DA (July 2026 hike expected at 63%).
